title: When agents outrun the reviewers
subtitle: A week of arguments for moving trust out of code review and into the system around it
editor_note: Agents now write code faster than anyone can read it, and four of this week's six saves ask what to do about that. Lauren starts with the comments agents copy and ends with a pyramid for the whole codebase, the Claude Code team shows the layered checks it runs at 90% agent-written code, and Addy Osmani names the shift: review becomes verification. Felix Rieseberg asks for bigger goals, and Jev's thread shows models that reason with pictures.
